snippet.title: PulseWave - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4607180/PulseWave/

Use the beat to survive.
PulseWave is a rhythm-shooter roguelike where every weapon fires to the beat you create. Build your rhythm, combine weapons and modifiers, and turn simple patterns into devastating sequences.

Music:
Augusto Diniz
